SATB Benchmark & Telemetry Audit [E · measured_j / reported_j]

Across 5 hosts (Jetson AGX Thor TI INA238/INA3221 DC shunts + 4 counter hosts), the Rust SATB harness passed 12/12 replay checks while exposing 32.59%-89.88% Kepler CPU-splitting errors.

1/2 Exposed attribution errors:
- C1-C12 & Shape D / C9 replay: 0 byte diffs across macOS arm64, Tegra Linux, 2 x86-64 Linux hosts & Windows 11
- Falsifier 2: CPU-share splitting erred 32.59%-89.88% on DRAM/GPU loads
- Falsifier 3: Win32 15.625 ms ticks missed -89.88%

2/2 Shared-host honesty & L0 scope:
- Falsifier 6 withholds net marginal A1 joules whenever pre/post idle power drifts > 5.0%
- Thor INA238/INA3221 (measured_j) is never summed with M5 Max, Zen 5, Core i9, or NVML (reported_j)
- AC wall meter (L0) was not attached
